---
title: Validate Cloud-Ready Vector Data with Tissot
---

## Overview

This cookbook shows a practical workflow for validating vector data readiness with [Tissot](https://github.com/chrislyonsKY/tissot), a geospatial diagnostics CLI.

It focuses on commands that are available in the current prerelease and suitable for CI and pull request checks.

Discussion thread: [Cloud Native Geo discussion](https://github.com/cloudnativegeo/cloud-optimized-geospatial-formats-guide/discussions?discussions_q=).

## Prerequisites

Install Tissot from the current prerelease tag:

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/chrislyonsKY/tissot.git --tag v0.1.0-alpha.1 tissot --force
```

## Create Open Example Data

This example uses synthetic open data created locally.

```bash
cat > sample.geojson <<'EOF'
{
  "type": "FeatureCollection",
  "features": [
    {
      "type": "Feature",
      "geometry": {"type": "Point", "coordinates": [-84.5, 38.0]},
      "properties": {"name": "a"}
    }
  ]
}
EOF
```

## Run Diagnostics

Run a standard check:

```bash
tissot check sample.geojson --terminal
```

Run SARIF output for code scanning and CI ingestion:

```bash
tissot check sample.geojson --sarif > results.sarif
```

## Score and Badge

Create a quality score report:

```bash
tissot score sample.geojson --terminal
```

Generate a badge for repository status pages:

```bash
tissot score sample.geojson --badge tissot-score.svg
```

## Suggested CI Step

Add a lightweight gate in CI:

```bash
tissot check data/sample.geojson --sarif > tissot-results.sarif
```

Upload the SARIF artifact or ingest it into your security workflow.
